sn12.4:1.2: Vipassissa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa pubbeva sambodhā anabhisambuddhassa bodhisattassa sato etad ahosi || ||
sn12.4:1.3: Kicchaṃ vatāyaṃ loko āpanno jāyati ca jīyati ca mīyati ca cavati ca upapajjati ca ||
sn12.4:1.4: Atha ca panimassa dukkhassa nissaraṇaṃ nappajānāti jarāmaraṇassa ||
sn12.4:1.5: kudassu nāma imassa dukkhassa nissaraṇaṃ paññāyissati jarāmaraṇassāti || || 3
sn12.4:2.1: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa bodhisattassa etad ahosi || ||
sn12.4:2.2: Kimhi nu kho sati jarāmaraṇaṃ hoti kimpaccayā jarāmaraṇan ti || ||
sn12.4:2.3: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa bodhisattassa yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo ||
sn12.4:2.4: jātiyā kho sati jarāmaraṇaṃ hoti jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇanti || || 4
sn12.4:3.1: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa bodhisattassa etad ahosi || ||
sn12.4:3.2: Kimhi nu kho sati jāti hoti kiṃpaccayā jātīti || ||
sn12.4:3.3: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa bodhisattassa yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo ||
sn12.4:3.4: bhave kho sati jāti hoti bhavapaccayā jātīti || || 5
sn12.4:4.1: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissabodhisattassa etad ahosi ||
sn12.4:4.2: Kimhi nu kho sati bhavo hoti kimpaccayā bhavo ti || ||
sn12.4:4.3: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissabodhisattassa yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo ||
sn12.4:4.4: upādāne kho sati bhavo hoti upādānapaccayā bhavo ti || || 6
sn12.4:5.1: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa bodhisattassa etad ahosi || ||
sn12.4:5.2: Kimhi nu kho sati upādānaṃ hoti kimpaccayā upādānan ti || ||
sn12.4:5.3: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa bodhisattassa yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo ||
sn12.4:5.4: taṇhāya kho sati upādānaṃ hoti tanhāpaccayā upādānan ti || || 7
sn12.4:6.1: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa bodhisattassa etad ahosi || ||
sn12.4:6.2: Kimhi nu kho sati taṇhā hoti kimpaccayā taṇhā ti || ||
sn12.4:6.3: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa bodhisattassa yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo ||
sn12.4:6.4: vedanāya kho sati taṇhā hoti vedanāpaccayā taṇhāti || || 8
sn12.4:7.1: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa bodhisattassa etad ahosi || ||
sn12.4:7.2: Kimhi nu kho sati vedanā hoti kim paccayā vedanā ti || ||
sn12.4:7.3: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa bodhisattassa yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo ||
sn12.4:7.4: phasse kho sati vedanā hoti phassapaccayā vedanā ti || || 9
sn12.4:8.1: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassassa bodhisattassa etad ahosi || ||
sn12.4:8.2: Kimhi nu kho sati phasso hoti kimpaccayā phassoti || ||
sn12.4:8.3: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa bodhisattassa yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo ||
sn12.4:8.4: saḷāyatane kho sati phasso hoti saḷāyatanapaccayā phassoti || || 10
sn12.4:9.1: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa bodhisattassa etad ahosi ||
sn12.4:9.2: Kimhi nu kho sati saḷāyatanaṃ hoti kimpaccayā saḷāyatananti || ||
sn12.4:9.3: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa bodhisattassa yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo ||
sn12.4:9.4: Nāmarūpe kho sati saḷāyatanaṃ hoti nāmarūpapaccayā saḷāyatananti || || 11
sn12.4:10.1: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa bodhisattassa etad ahosi ||
sn12.4:10.2: Kimhi nu kho sati nāmarūpaṃ hoti kimpaccayā nāmarūpanti || ||
sn12.4:10.3: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa bodhisattassa yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo ||
sn12.4:10.4: Viññāṇe kho sati nāmarūpaṃ hoti viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpanti || || 12
sn12.4:11.1: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa bodhisattassa etad ahosi ||
sn12.4:11.2: Kimhi nu kho sati viññāṇaṃ kimpaccayā viññāṇanti || ||
sn12.4:11.3: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa bodhisattassa yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo ||
sn12.4:11.4: Saṅkhāresu kho sati viññāṇaṃ hoti saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇanti || || 13
sn12.4:12.1: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa bodhisattassa etad ahosi ||
sn12.4:12.2: Kimhi nu kho sati saṅkhārā honti kimpaccayā saṅkhārāti || ||
sn12.4:12.3: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa bodhisattassa yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo ||
sn12.4:12.4: avijjāya kho sati saṅkhārā honti avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārāti || || 14
sn12.4:13.3: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti || || 15
sn12.4:13.4: Samudayo samudayo ti kho bhikkhave Vipassissa bodhisattassa pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhum udapādi ñāṇam udapādi paññā udapādi vijjā udapādi āloko udapādi || || 16
sn12.4:14.1: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa bodhisattassa etad ahosi || ||
sn12.4:14.2: Kimhi nu kho asati jarāmaraṇaṃ na hoti kissa nirodhā jarāmaraṇanirodhoti || ||
sn12.4:14.3: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa bodhisattassa yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo ||
sn12.4:14.4: jātiyā kho asati jarāmaraṇaṃ na hoti jātinirodhā jarāmaraṇanirodhoti || || 17
sn12.4:15.1: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa bodhisattassa etad ahosi ||
sn12.4:15.2: Kimhi nu kho asati jāti na hoti kissa nirodhā jātinirodhoti || ||
sn12.4:15.3: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa bodhisattassa yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo ||
sn12.4:15.4: bhave kho asati jāti na hoti bhavanirodhā jātinirodho hoti || || 18
sn12.4:16.1: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa bodhisattassa etad ahosi ||
sn12.4:16.2: Kimhi nu kho asati bhavo na hoti kissa nirodhā bhavanirodhoti || ||
sn12.4:16.3: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa bodhisattassa yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo ||
sn12.4:16.4: upādāne kho asati bhavo na hoti upadānanirodhā bhavanirodhoti || || 19
sn12.4:17.1: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa bodhisattassa etad ahosi ||
sn12.4:17.2: Kimhi nu kho asati upādānam na hoti kissa nirodhā upādānanirodhoti || ||
sn12.4:17.3: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa bodhisattassa yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo ||
sn12.4:17.4: taṇhāya kho asati upādānaṃ na hoti taṇhānirodhā upādāna nirodhoti || || 20
sn12.4:18.1: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa bodhisattassa etad ahosi ||
sn12.4:18.2: Kimhi nu kho asati taṇhā na hoti kissa nirodhā taṇhānirodhoti || ||
sn12.4:18.3: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa bodhisattassa yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo ||
sn12.4:18.4: Vedanāya kho asati taṇhā na hoti vedanānirodhā taṇhānirodhoti || || 21
sn12.4:19.1: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa bodhisattassa etad ahosi ||
sn12.4:19.2: Kimhi nu kho asati vedanā na hoti kissa nirodhā vedanānirodhoti || ||
sn12.4:19.3: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa bodhisattassa yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo ||
sn12.4:19.4: phasse kho asati vedanā na hoti phassanirodhā vedanānirodhoti || || 22
sn12.4:20.1: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa bodhisattassa etad ahosi ||
sn12.4:20.2: Kimhi nu kho asati phasso na hoti kissa nirodhā phassanirodhoti || ||
sn12.4:20.3: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa bodhisattassa yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo ||
sn12.4:20.4: saḷāyatane kho asati phasso na hoti saḷāyatananirodhā phassanirodhoti || || 23
sn12.4:21.1: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa bodhisattassa etad ahosi ||
sn12.4:21.2: Kiṃhi nu kho asati saḷāyatanaṃ na hoti kissa nirodhā saḷāyatana-nirodhoti || ||
sn12.4:21.3: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa bodhisattassa yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo ||
sn12.4:21.4: nāmarūpe kho asati saḷāyatanaṃ na hoti nāmarūpanirodhā saḷāyatananirodhoti || || 24
sn12.4:22.1: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa bodhisattassa etad ahosi ||
sn12.4:22.2: Kimhi nu kho asati nāmarūpaṃ na hoti kissa nirodhā nāmarūpanirodhoti || ||
sn12.4:22.3: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa bodhisattassa yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo ||
sn12.4:22.4: Viññāṇe kho asati nāmarūpam na hoti viññāṇanirodhā nāmarūpanirodhoti || || 25
sn12.4:23.1: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa bodhisattassa etad ahosi ||
sn12.4:23.2: Kimhi nu kho asati viññāṇaṃ na hoti kissa nirodhā viññāṇanirodhoti || ||
sn12.4:23.3: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa bodhisattassa yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo ||
sn12.4:23.4: saṅkhāresu kho asati viññāṇaṃ na hoti saṅkhāranirodhā viññāṇanirodhoti || || 26
sn12.4:24.1: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa bodhisattassa etad ahosi ||
sn12.4:24.2: Kimhi nu kho asati saṅkhārā na honti kissa nirodhā saṅkhāranirodhoti || ||
sn12.4:24.3: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa bodhisattassa yoniso manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo ||
sn12.4:24.4: avijjāya kho asati saṅkhārā na honti avijjānirodhā saṅkhāranirodhoti || || 27
sn12.4:25.3: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hoti || || 28
sn12.4:25.4: Nirodho nirodhoti kho bhikkhave Vipassissa bodhisattassa pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhum udapādi ñāṇam udapādi paññā udapādi vijjā udapādi āloko udapādīti || ||
